# Troubleshooting notes

When the compiler fails you will usually see something like main.go:12: error in the log,
but the useful part is the message after it. Teams often paste output such as
`handler.go:30:5: warning` into tickets without saying which tool printed it.

Another common thing is a stack frame like at Foo.bar(Foo.java:12) inside a quoted
paragraph, which is only an example and not a trace. Keep the text as it is, because the
document explains how to read these lines rather than reporting a real failure. Reviewers
asked for more detail on this section, so the paragraph is intentionally long enough to be
worth keeping around when the notes are read again later by someone who has not seen them.
